startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Finn job search URLs (filters included), e.g. https://www.finn.no/job/search?q=utvikler&location=1.20001.20012. Optional - you can use keywords instead.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One or more search terms, e.g. utvikler, developer, backend. Each keyword is searched separately and duplicate jobs are removed.

keyword.title: Single keyword (optional)
keyword.description: Shortcut for one search term. Added to the Keywords list.

location.title: Location
location.description: County or municipality name (e.g. Rogaland, Haugesund, Oslo) or a Finn location code like 1.20001.20012. Applied to every keyword; ignored for Start URLs.

maxJobs.title: Maximum number of jobs
maxJobs.description: Total number of jobs to save across all keywords and URLs.

maxPages.title: Maximum search pages per search
maxPages.description: Safety limit on result pages per search (about 50 jobs per page).

includeDetails.title: Fetch full ad details
includeDetails.description: Adds the full description (text and HTML), employer website, employment type and exact deadline. Turn off for the fastest basic listing.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Works without a proxy; enable Apify Proxy only if Finn blocks your requests.
